description: Player 1's sixty-card library for R80 and R316: a deck of LIBRARY_CAP cards (the handicap's deckSize, R184, the only way to hold one) with #33 Unstable Clone Machine, which shuffles 3 copies of every card its controller plays afterwards into the library. The opening 3 and the turn-1 draw leave 56; the handicap's manaBonus 3 (manaCap 4, a human's) makes turn 1 a 4-mana turn, enough for the Clone Machine (2) and two 1-cost Units. The first Unit's copies take the library to 59; the second's first copy fills it to 60 and its other two are refused and never created (`libraryOverflow`, outcome notCreated), on seat 1's own device. The spec's seed deals the Clone Machine, #4 Gary the Gambler and #8 Mr. Vanilla to seat 1 by turn 1 (Gary's Cry flips coins and asks nothing; Mr. Vanilla is vanilla), so the refused card is Mr. Vanilla. The sixty are the Clone Machine, the cheap cards a spec can play with a click and a zone, then Core order, leaving out every card that acts from a hand or a library by itself: no Cast-on-draw (#21, #27), no Quickdraw (#65, #84, #98), no hand trigger (#89), no start-of-game roll (#98), and not #90 CN-Viral Injection, which is seat 2's.
